passage:
Vlad is a crab. 
Vlad the crab ran on the sand. 
A crab trap was in the sand. 
Vlad did not see the trap.

Vlad ran in to the trap. 
“Help!” said Vlad. 
Dax the crab sees Vlad. 
“I can help you!” said Dax. 
Dax acts fast.

He grabs Vlad. 
Dax and Vlad ran from the trap. 
The crabs are glad.
